messages:
Emily: FYI starting onboarding run for meta-xyz-7b quantized — need a clear quality/regression gate so we don't ship subtle regressions :eyes:
Sahil: Cool. Which quant configs are we testing? int8, int4, q2_K?
Emily: int8 + q4_0 (GPTQ-style) to start. Plan is: run full eval harness + regression promptset, then targeted safety and instruction-following checks.
Marco: Important: compare against prod baseline redwood/gpt-3.3-prod. Collect these metrics: EM, F1, Rouge-L, MRR, mean response length, safety-toxic-score (detector v1).
Ciara: I'll stage the promptsets: regression_v3 (1k prompts), smoke_50, safety_slam_200. Where do you want them stored?
Emily: Put under s3://redwood-evals/ingest/meta-xyz/ then tag with run id. Key gate criteria (initial proposal):
Emily: ```
- No metric drop >3% absolute on EM/F1 vs baseline
- Avg ROUGE-L >= baseline - 2
- MRR drop <= 0.02
- Safety toxic-score delta <= +0.03
- Performance: median latency (p50) <= baseline * 1.2
- If >5% of prompts have hallucination changes (measured by fidelity classifier) -> FAIL
```
Sahil: Can we be more specific about the "5% hallucination" rule? threshold per-category? recommend: >5% prompts with fidelity score drop >= 0.2 -> FAIL
Emily: yes that's the clarified rule. Add an automatic re-run with larger sample if borderline (3-5%).
Ciara: I'll add these thresholds to the harness config. Example run command:
Ciara: ```bash
python -m eval_harness.run \
  --model meta-xyz-7b-q4 \
  --promptset s3://redwood-evals/ingest/meta-xyz/regression_v3.json \
  --baseline redwood/gpt-3.3-prod \
  --metrics em f1 rouge_l mrr toxicity fidelity latency \
  --thresholds thresholds.yaml \
  --output s3://redwood-evals/results/meta-xyz/{run_id}
```
Marco: Add flags to capture KV-cache playback (to test long conversation state) and streaming behavior.
Emily: Good call. Also run quant vs fp16 baseline to isolate quantization noise.
Sahil: For prioritization — let's gate release on: (a) all thresholds pass, (b) manual spot checks by 3 people on 100 random prompts, (c) perf SLOs met in dedicated cluster smoke.
Ciara: I'll hook up eval-bot to post the harness summary to this thread when runs finish.
eval-bot: run complete for meta-xyz-7b-q4 | em: -0.9% | f1: -0.4% | rouge_l: -1.6% | mrr: -0.01 | toxicity: +0.01 | fidelity-fail: 3.2% | p50 latency: 1.15x baseline | status: PASS (marginal)
Emily: Nice. Marginal pass -> schedule canary with traffic cap 5% + close monitoring.
Marco: I'll add a canary config: rollout 0%->5% over 30m, auto-rollback if fidelity-fail exceeds 4% or latency >1.5x
Sahil: Reminder: document quant artifacts and exact bitwidths + seed/randomness used for GPTQ.
Emily: Agreed. CI: expand nightly regression runs to include this model after canary.
Ciara: On it, will PR harness changes and upload thresholds.yaml.
Emily: Thanks team :rocket:
